title: State management: server state and UI state separated, stale-while-revalidate reads, explicit invalidation on writes
description: Client state is split into a server-state cache and local UI state, managed separately. Reads default to stale-while-revalidate: cached data renders immediately while a background refresh runs. Writes explicitly invalidate the affected cache entries. Optimistic updates are applied only where the write is highly likely to succeed and are rolled back visibly on failure.
rationale: Mixing server and UI state is the root of most SPA data bugs: stale lists after writes, flicker on navigation, and phantom optimistic state. The split plus explicit invalidation makes cache behaviour specifiable.
